title: New menu items are accessible by default is true only of the two seeded roles; API-minted roles get allowNewMenu false
statement: The permissions manual states that new menu items are accessible by default and that the setting is enabled by default. It is enabled because the installer writes allowNewMenu: true literally into the admin and member seed records. The roles column has no defaultValue, and neither POST /api/roles:create nor the New role drawer supplies one, so every role a user creates starts with allowNewMenu: false.

handVerified.note: Report section 8, both halves. roles:create returned allowNewMenu:false and roles:get confirmed it persisted. Control: admin and member are both true and root is false, a third data point the finding did not mention and which does not change it. The report corrects the findings.md cite for the column from :78-81 to :77-80.

source.howDecided: git log d8d8cb4b..origin/main -- <culprit files> returned 0 commits for every file in this finding. The only three commits since the tested SHA are 24a620efb8 and 032a4f6913 (lerna version bumps, packages/*/package.json and lerna.json only) and ba00bcebc2 (CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md). The culprit lines were then re-read at origin/main and match the report's quotes.

reevaluation: The finding stands unchanged and the report's cite correction is right. None of the three source files nor permissions.md has a commit since the tested SHA. At today's head the allowNewMenu column object is roles.ts:77-80 with no defaultValue, allowNewMenu: true is written literally at server.ts:451 (admin) and server.ts:458 (member), and NewRole.tsx:46-47 still returns only name and snippets. The doc sentence is verbatim at permissions.md:19. The allowNewMenu search returned two unrelated items (#9281 approval form rendering, #249 from 2022). Unreported.
notes: Use the corrected cite roles.ts:77-80, not findings.md's :78-81. The one-line fix (defaultValue: true on the column) is worth naming, but flag the compatibility question honestly: changing the default changes the meaning of every existing role row that is false because nothing set it. An equally valid resolution is a doc change, so offer both. Label vocabulary check: the 40 most recent nocobase/nocobase issues carry ZERO labels, so maintainers here rarely label outside triage. The labels suggested are real repo labels (verified via gh api repos/nocobase/nocobase/labels), but a Suggested labels line will probably go unused. The only issue template is bug_report.md with sections: Describe the bug, Environment, How To Reproduce, Expected behavior, Screenshots, Logs. No template-enforcing workflow was detected, but match the sections anyway.
